parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence or documented targeting/violence is established, and no official violence was cited in 2023, so this is not an organised-targeting case. However, vague good-morals provisions are treated as de facto criminalising and are reported as used against people, leaving a visible trans visitor exposed to prosecution for public conduct. Pervasive social/religious intolerance and taboo are documented, there is no general discrimination remedy for service/facility refusal, and complaint routes are not shown to work. Thin, dated documentation cannot be read as safety; extrapolating from de facto criminalisation, intolerance, no recourse and general harsh-detention context resolves toward high/elevated risk.
